summary.implementedScope: Implemented deterministic chunk lifecycle by adding persisted chunk store operations, validating chunk close settings, and building the chunk service that promotes closed smoothed turns into ordered chunk state while enforcing the one-open-chunk invariant and deterministic soft/hard closure behavior.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

changedFiles.reason: Added chunk persistence read/write contracts so async-thread services can manage persisted chunk lifecycle state.
Persisted `chunks.json` for each thread and implemented atomic chunk read/write operations guarded by existing thread mutation checks.
Added deterministic chunk close settings validation used by the chunk lifecycle service.
Implemented chunk eligibility, ordered appends, one-open-chunk enforcement, deterministic soft-threshold closure, hard-max closure, and blocker reporting.
Added Story 2 coverage for all 11 mapped TCs plus the hard-max next-open non-TC regression.
Updated the persisted thread artifact expectation to include the new `chunks.json` file.
